desc: I have seen a lot of camps. Raider hovels bolted to cliff faces. Responder outposts with a bed and a prayer. One guy who built entirely underground and refused to explain himself. But I was not prepared for this — a full neon casino rising out of the Appalachian dark, red carpet rolled out, giant dice painted across the facade, and a wall of masks staring at you like the wasteland's most unsettling gift shop. The sign out front reads kill laugh love in pink neon. It is the most optimistic thing I have seen since the bombs fell. Vendor's stocked. Friends are welcome. The house probably still wins.
